reason: The user requests actual source supers where they exist. The first generic physical solo action is not accepted as a replacement for the original Burning Vigor move.

entries.name: Super Guts Bullet
entries.sourceDescription: Batsu’s Super Guts Bullet is a Burning Vigor attack in the original1997 Rival Schools, independently listed by the period move guides. An actual palm releases the enlarged Guts projectile. The1997 source frame timing and exact palette remain uncertified.

entries.name: Super Cross Cutter
entries.sourceDescription: Super Cross Cutter is Kyosuke’s original Rival Schools Burning Vigor attack. His hands release crossed energy cutters. Last Symphony is a different Team Up technique and must not silently create teammates in this solo atlas. Exact1997 palette, source frames and fan spread remain uncertified.

entries.name: Fire Senpuu-Kyaku
entries.sourceDescription: Fire Senpuu-Kyaku is Hinata’s Burning Vigor technique in the original Rival Schools. Its physical rotating kick uses fire around the kicking leg; it is not a thrown hand fireball or a Team Up summoning another pupil. Exact source hit count, frame timing and palette remain adapted and uncertified.
